title: Filen - Cloud Storage
summary: Fully client side end to end encrypted cloud storage
description:
Backup your photos, documents and videos with Filen, the most secure cloud storage solution. Your first 10 GB are completely free.

Leveraging the power of end to end encryption your privacy will always be protected when using Filen. Nobody except you will have access to your files!

Share files with collegues, friends and family with a click of a button.

Preview images, videos, audio files and documents directly in the app to boost your productivity.

Save files for offline access, so you can view them even without having an internet connection.

What are you waiting for? Start using Filen today!
